samples.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this approved children's game sample with ONE change only: make the ENVIRONMENT BACKGROUND noticeably less attention-grabbing. Preserve the bridge, its angle and all its structural panels and rails, missing gap and its glow, the bird, girl picture bubble, map icon, progress dots, speaker and three answer boards EXACTLY. Preserve all Hindi text: मीरा पौधों को [gap] दे रही है। and पानी / मिट्टी / फल. Modify ONLY scenery: river calm muted blue-turquoise with almost no surface sparkle or caustics, remove submerged stones, reduce grass detail to broad softly textured natural banks, remove nearly all flowers and tiny scattered pebbles. Through the missing bridge gap also show this same calmer water. Keep the foreground wood's current rich golden color and navy text untouched. Background about 30% less saturated, substantially lower microcontrast and fewer tiny details, subtle natural depth softness. Keep recognizable beautiful dimensional 3D material rendering and original color family, not flat/vector/clay, not gray or washed-out. Main words and gameplay objects should command the first glance. Do NOT blur or desaturate foreground, picture bubble or UI. Do not add text or new objects. Keep landscape16:9. Output the edited full sample only.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign ONLY the staircase construction and surrounding environment in this children's Hindi sentence game sample; preserve Swifty's character, picture bubble, all 8 option labels and their order, small map/speaker/progress interface, and the same large readable foreground layout and 16:9 composition. IMPORTANT LOGIC FIX: currently there are solid walkable stairs already, which makes building pointless. New concept: a small elevated natural stone ledge/platform at upper-right, with a simple vertical rock face behind it. There is NO slope or alternate walkable stairway. TWO slim diagonal timber side-stringers lead up toward the platform, with five step positions between them. Only the FIRST low step is installed, broad warm honey-gold wood with the word 'लड़की'. The next FOUR stair treads are COMPLETELY MISSING: show unmistakable open AIR SPACES between side beams, the plain cool blue-gray cliff visible through these gaps, not solid blank wooden risers, not stone stairs underneath, not already walkable surfaces. Indicate each missing tread only with a faint thin dashed warm outline and tiny empty support notches. Do not fill the four gaps with any solid material. The eight option blocks at bottom are actual thick wooden STEP TREADS that would physically fill these missing slots, broad flat tops with upright readable fronts. Exact options two rows of four: 'लड़की', 'गाना', 'गा', 'रही'; 'है।', 'खेल', 'किताब', 'रहा'. First लड़की option dimmed as used; others honey-gold matching installed step. Dark navy type, crisp and very legible. Environment RELEVANT to climbing: simple small cliff/platform only, no waterfall, mountains, village, river or dense foliage. Muted desaturated sage and cool blue-gray stone background, plain sand foreground, very few soft shrubs at extreme edges, no flower carpets or sparkling textures. Foreground warm golden wood and bird retain vibrant original color against quiet cooler scenery. Maintain polished coherent natural 3D cartoon rendering, soft sunlight, don't use flat/clay style. Picture bubble still clearly shows girl singing with music notes. No new text, captions or instruction paragraphs. The visual must make it clear: pieces are MISSING, so the child must construct real steps to reach the platform.
